name: Compressarr SD-HD Opus 7.1 v1
description: The same as Compressarr SD-HD (x265 10-bit, crop, English subtitles and chapters) but the first English audio track is encoded as Opus, which carries 7.1 surround (E-AC3 stops at 5.1). Opus is not played by every TV, soundbar or media box - if yours cannot, use Compressarr SD-HD instead.
